use default

digits(value: int, base: int) -> LIST[int] is
    let result = LIST()
    let remaining mut = value

    while remaining > 0 do
        result.add(remaining % base)
        remaining = remaining / base
    od

    result
si

prime_factor_sum(value: int) -> int is
    let total mut = 0
    let remaining mut = value
    let factor mut = 2

    while factor * factor <= remaining do
        while remaining % factor == 0 do
            total = total + factor
            remaining = remaining / factor
        od

        factor = factor + 1
    od

    if remaining > 1 then total + remaining else total fi
si

is_rhonda(value: int, base: int) -> bool =>
    digits(value, base) |> reduce(1, (product, d) => product * d) ==
    base * prime_factor_sum(value)

rhondas(base: int) -> Pipe[int] is
    let candidate mut = 1

    do
        candidate = candidate + 1

        if is_rhonda(candidate, base) then
            yield candidate
        fi
    od
si

is_prime(value: int) -> bool is
    let divisor mut = 2

    while divisor * divisor <= value do
        if value % divisor == 0 then return false fi
        divisor = divisor + 1
    od

    value > 1
si

write_line("the first ten Rhonda numbers, shown in base ten:")

for base in (2::36) |> filter(b => !is_prime(b)) do
    let found = rhondas(base) |> take(10) |> map(term => "{term,8}")

    write_line("base {base,2}:{found |> join("")}")
